name: Jeolmanghui 1-bu ~Ilh-eobeorin Nag-won~
source:
The girl who calls herself Riapse. By her hand the world is destroyed. But story does not stop here. It only begins. The story of despair and desire after losing the paradise. 

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/09/vn-of-month-september-2008-sumaga.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
一名自称莉亚普丝的少女亲手毁灭了世界。然而，故事并未就此停止，而是刚刚开始。这是失去乐园之后，关于绝望与欲望的故事。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/09/vn-of-month-september-2008-sumaga.html]vndbreview[/url]]
